title: Make the machines that serve the operator's goals start on boot
description: Make the one machine still missing onboot start on boot. MEASURED 2026-10-06 after the host rebooted: `grep onboot /etc/pve/lxc/*.conf /etc/pve/qemu-server/*.conf` shows onboot: 1 on every container (101-105, 111, 120, 130) and on VM 106 palworld-server -- all of which came back on their own after that reboot. Only VM 100 gpu-vm and VM 110 ai-vm have no onboot line. OPERATOR DECISION 2026-10-06: set onboot on VM 110 ai-vm ONLY. Do NOT set it on VM 100 gpu-vm: both are 16 GB GPU hosts and one GPU cannot be passed through to two running VMs, so starting both at boot would leave the second unable to start. Done when /etc/pve/qemu-server/110.conf carries onboot: 1 and 100.conf still has no onboot line.
